about: 38 original recipes written for this project (not copied or paraphrased from any book, site or database). Loaded by scripts/original-recipes.mjs. Each recipe ingredient names a key in 'ingredients'. Ingredients for data/recipes/original-v2.json. 'reuse' names an existing real ingredient revision (scripts/real-recipes.mjs); its statements stay as they are and must match what is written here. Every other entry is a new real ingredient whose nutrition comes from the named USDA FoodData Central food, per 100 g. Families and allergens list only what is present or not known; every other family is absent by statement for the plain ingredient. Diets are a curator assessment of the plain ingredient: brands differ, check packaged labels.

recipes.name: Tofu and black bean breakfast tacos
recipes.description: Warm corn tortillas filled with cumin-spiced crumbled tofu, black beans and a spoon of salsa. A filling breakfast that comes together in one pan.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is three tacos.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Warm the oil in the frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion until soft and starting to colour.

steps.title: Cook the tofu
steps.text: Crumble the tofu into the pan with your fingers. Add the cumin, paprika, turmeric and salt and stir until the tofu is evenly golden and hot.

steps.title: Add the beans
steps.text: Stir in the black beans and a splash of water. Cook until the beans are heated through, then taste for salt.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Heat the tortillas one or two at a time in a dry pan, about 30 seconds a side, and keep them wrapped in a clean towel.

steps.title: Fill and serve
steps.text: Spoon the filling into the tortillas and top with salsa and coriander.

recipes.name: Spinach chickpea-flour pancakes
recipes.description: Thin savoury pancakes made from a chickpea-flour batter with spinach, onion and a little chili. Good with yogurt or chutney for breakfast or a light lunch.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is three pancakes.

ingredients.note: Greek yogurt in place of soy yogurt, if you eat dairy.

steps.title: Make the batter
steps.text: Whisk the chickpea flour, cumin, turmeric and salt with the water until smooth, like a thin pancake batter. Leave it to rest for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.text: Stir the spinach, onion and chili into the batter.

steps.title: Cook the pancakes
steps.text: Heat the pan over medium heat and brush it with a little oil. Pour in a small ladle of batter and spread it thin. Cook until the edges lift and the underside is golden, then flip and cook the other side.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Make the rest of the pancakes the same way, oiling the pan lightly each time. Keep the cooked ones warm under a plate.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve warm with the yogurt on the side.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese bowl with strawberries and pepitas
recipes.description: Cool cottage cheese with sliced strawberries, crunchy pumpkin seeds and a thread of maple syrup. No cooking, and plenty of protein to start the day.
recipes.servingNote: Makes one bowl.

modifications.vegetarian: Some cottage cheese is set with animal rennet: choose one the label says uses microbial or no rennet.

steps.title: Start the bowl
steps.text: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Scatter over the strawberries and pumpkin seeds.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle with the maple syrup, add a pinch of cinnamon and eat straight away.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt with cinnamon apple and almonds
recipes.description: Thick yogurt under quickly warmed cinnamon apple and toasted almonds. A five-minute breakfast with a soft, sweet topping and no added sugar beyond a little maple.
recipes.servingNote: Makes one bowl.

ingredients.note: Soy yogurt in place of Greek yogurt makes the bowl vegan, with much less protein.

steps.title: Toast the almonds
steps.text: Toast the almonds in the dry pan over medium heat, shaking often, until they smell nutty. Tip them out.

steps.title: Warm the apple
steps.text: Add the apple, cinnamon, maple syrup and a tablespoon of water to the same pan. Cook, stirring, until the apple just softens.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and top with the warm apple and the almonds.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta egg muffins
recipes.description: Little baked egg cups with wilted spinach, red pepper and crumbled feta. Make a tray on Sunday and keep them in the fridge for quick breakfasts.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is three muffins.

ingredients.prep: plus a little for the tin

modifications.vegetarian: Feta is often made with animal rennet: choose one the label says uses microbial or vegetable rennet.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F). Brush the muffin tin with a little oil.

steps.title: Wilt the vegetables
steps.text: Warm the oil in the frying pan and cook the red pepper for two minutes. Add the spinach and stir until it collapses. Let it cool a little.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the oregano, salt and pepper. Stir in the vegetables and the feta.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Divide the mixture between the six holes. Bake until puffed and set in the middle.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.text: Leave in the tin for a few minutes, then loosen with a knife. Eat warm, or cool and refrigerate for up to three days.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana toast with hemp seeds
recipes.description: Whole-wheat toast spread with peanut butter, topped with sliced banana, hemp seeds and a dusting of cinnamon. Quick, filling and easy to carry.
recipes.servingNote: Two slices of toast.

modifications.vegan: Some sliced breads contain milk, egg or honey: for a vegan sandwich choose a loaf whose label lists none.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the bread until golden.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread the peanut butter over the warm toast so it softens.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Lay the banana slices on top and sprinkle with hemp seeds and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Ginger rice porridge with tofu and bok choy
recipes.description: A soft, savoury rice porridge cooked with plenty of ginger, finished with silky tofu, bok choy, scallions and a few drops of soy and sesame. Gentle and warming.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one large bowl.

steps.title: Simmer the rice
steps.text: Put the rice, water, half the ginger and the salt in the pot. Bring to the boil, then lower the heat, cover partly and simmer, stirring now and then so it does not catch.

steps.title: Check the texture
steps.text: The rice should have broken down into a thick, creamy porridge. Add a little hot water if it is stiffer than you like.

steps.title: Add tofu and greens
steps.text: Stir in the tofu and bok choy and simmer until the greens are tender and the tofu is hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls. Top with the scallions and the rest of the ginger, then drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Eggs on spiced pinto beans with salsa
recipes.description: Fried eggs on smoky, garlicky pinto beans with warm corn tortillas and fresh salsa. A hearty breakfast or an easy weeknight supper.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is two eggs on half the beans, with two tortillas.

ingredients.note: Pan-fried slices of extra-firm tofu in place of the eggs make the plate vegan.

steps.title: Warm the spices
steps.text: Heat half the oil in the small pot over medium heat. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the beans
steps.text: Add the beans with a few spoonfuls of their liquid and the salt. Simmer, mashing about half of them, until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Heat the rest of the oil in the frying pan and fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks are as you like them.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.text: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a gas flame for a few seconds a side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the beans onto plates, put the eggs on top and finish with salsa. Serve the tortillas alongside.

recipes.name: Apple cinnamon baked oatmeal
recipes.description: Oats, apple, walnuts and soy milk baked into a soft, sliceable breakfast. Make it once and reheat squares through the week.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a quarter of the dish.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F) and lightly oil the baking dish.

steps.title: Mix the dry
steps.text: Stir the oats, flaxseed, cinnamon, baking powder and salt together in the bowl.

steps.title: Add the wet
steps.text: Pour in the soy milk, maple syrup and vanilla and stir. Fold in most of the apple and walnuts.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the dish, scatter the rest of the apple and walnuts over the top and bake until golden and just set in the centre.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.text: Leave for 10 minutes before cutting into four squares. Keeps in the fridge for four days.

recipes.name: Berry, oat and silken tofu smoothie
recipes.description: A thick purple smoothie of blueberries, banana, oats, silken tofu and soy milk. Blended in a minute, it keeps you going until lunch.
recipes.servingNote: Makes one large glass.

steps.title: Load the blender
steps.text: Put the soy milk in the blender first, then the tofu, oats, hemp seeds, banana and blueberries.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend on high until completely smooth, about one minute. Add a splash more soy milk if it is too thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour into a glass and drink straight away.

recipes.name: Black bean, corn and avocado salad
recipes.description: Black beans and sweet corn tossed with peppers, red onion, jalapeño and lime, with creamy avocado folded in at the end. Good on its own or with tortilla chips.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the bowl.

ingredients.prep: red onion if you have it, finely diced

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Shake or whisk the lime juice, olive oil, cumin and salt together.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Put the beans, corn, pepper, onion and jalapeño in the bowl, pour over the dressing and toss well.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Leave for 10 minutes so the onion mellows and the beans take on the dressing.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Just before serving, fold in the avocado and coriander gently so the avocado keeps its shape. Taste for salt and lime.

recipes.name: Lentil and bulgur herb salad
recipes.description: Green lentils and bulgur with a big handful of parsley and mint, tomato, cucumber and a sharp lemon dressing. It keeps well, so it is ideal for packed lunches.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the bowl.

steps.title: Cook the lentils
steps.text: Cover the lentils with plenty of water and simmer until tender but still holding their shape. Drain well.

steps.title: Soak the bulgur
steps.text: Meanwhile put the bulgur in the heatproof bowl, pour over boiling water to cover by 1 cm and leave until tender. Drain off any water left.

steps.title: Dress while warm
steps.text: Mix the warm lentils and bulgur with the lemon juice, olive oil and salt in the large bowl and leave to cool.

steps.title: Add the fresh things
steps.text: Stir in the parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and scallions. Taste and add more lemon or salt if needed.

recipes.name: Hummus and roasted vegetable pita
recipes.description: Quick home-made hummus spread inside warm whole-wheat pita with oven-roasted eggplant, zucchini and pepper. Make the hummus ahead and lunch is ready in minutes.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one stuffed pita.

modifications.vegan: Some pita contains milk or honey: for a vegan meal choose one whose label lists neither.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Toss the eggplant, zucchini and pepper with most of the oil and half the salt on the tray. Roast, turning once, until soft and browned at the edges.

steps.title: Blend the hummus
steps.text: While they roast, blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and the rest of the salt and oil. Add the kept chickpea liquid a spoon at a time until smooth.

steps.title: Warm the pita
steps.text: Warm the pita in the oven for the last two minutes, then cut each one open into a pocket.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread a thick layer of hummus inside each pita and pack in the roasted vegetables.

recipes.name: Smoky tempeh, lettuce and tomato sandwich
recipes.description: Thin slices of tempeh glazed with soy, maple and smoked paprika until crisp, stacked with crunchy lettuce and ripe tomato on toasted whole-wheat bread.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one sandwich.

modifications.vegan: Some sliced breads contain milk, egg or honey: for a vegan sandwich choose a loaf whose label lists none.

steps.title: Mix the glaze
steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, maple syrup, smoked paprika and vinegar together in the small bowl.

steps.title: Crisp the tempeh
steps.text: Heat the oil in the frying pan over medium-high heat. Lay in the tempeh slices and fry until golden on both sides.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Pour the glaze over the tempeh and turn the slices until it bubbles away to a sticky coating. Take off the heat.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the bread, spread with mustard and layer the lettuce, tomato and tempeh. Close, press lightly and cut in half.

recipes.name: Cold soba with edamame and miso-sesame dressing
recipes.description: Chilled buckwheat noodles with edamame, cucumber and carrot in a nutty miso, sesame and lime dressing. Refreshing on a warm day and quick to pack.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one bowl.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.text: Boil the soba in plenty of water until just tender, stirring at the start so it does not stick. Add the edamame for the last minute.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Drain and rinse under cold running water, rubbing the noodles gently to wash off the starch. Drain well.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the miso, tahini, lime juice, sesame oil, maple syrup and water until smooth.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the noodles and edamame with the cucumber, carrot and dressing. Top with scallions and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: White bean, cucumber and feta salad
recipes.description: Creamy white beans with cucumber, tomato, olives and red onion in an oregano and red wine vinegar dressing, with salty feta crumbled over.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the bowl.

ingredients.prep: red onion if you have it, thinly sliced

ingredients.note: Extra chickpeas in place of the feta make the salad vegan.

modifications.vegetarian: Feta is often made with animal rennet: choose one the label says uses microbial or vegetable rennet.

steps.title: Dress the onion
steps.text: Put the onion in the bowl with the vinegar, oregano and salt and leave for five minutes to soften its bite.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.text: Add the beans, cucumber, tomato, olives and olive oil and toss gently.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Crumble the feta over the top and serve. Without the feta it keeps for a day in the fridge.

recipes.name: Smashed chickpea salad sandwich
recipes.description: Chickpeas roughly mashed with tahini, mustard, lemon, celery and dill, piled onto whole-wheat bread with lettuce. A creamy deli-style sandwich without mayonnaise.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one sandwich.

modifications.vegan: Some sliced breads contain milk, egg or honey: for a vegan sandwich choose a loaf whose label lists none.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Mash the chickpeas in the bowl until mostly broken but still a little chunky.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the tahini, mustard, lemon juice, celery, dill, hemp seeds, salt and pepper. Taste and adjust.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread the filling thickly on two slices of bread, add the lettuce and top with the other slices. Cut in half.

recipes.name: Tofu tikka wraps
recipes.description: Tofu marinated in spiced yogurt, browned in a hot pan with peppers and onion and rolled into warm wraps with a cucumber and mint yogurt sauce.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one large wrap.

ingredients.prep: pressed and cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.note: Paneer in place of tofu. Its protein is not known here (no USDA match), so the recipe total becomes not known.

ingredients.prep: for the marinade and the sauce

ingredients.note: Greek yogurt in place of soy yogurt, if you eat dairy.

modifications.vegan: Some flour tortillas contain lard, milk or honey: choose ones made with vegetable oil and check the label.
modifications.vegetarian: Some flour tortillas contain lard, milk or honey: choose ones made with vegetable oil and check the label.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: In the mixing bowl, stir two-thirds of the yogurt with the ginger, garlic, paprika, coriander, cumin, turmeric, salt and lemon juice. Fold in the tofu and leave for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Mix the rest of the yogurt with the cucumber and mint and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Heat half the oil in the frying pan over high heat and cook the pepper and onion until charred in places. Move them to a plate.

steps.title: Brown the tofu
steps.text: Add the rest of the oil and the tofu with its marinade. Cook, turning the pieces, until browned on several sides.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Warm the tortillas. Fill each one with tofu, vegetables and a spoon of the sauce, then roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Minestrone with white beans
recipes.description: A chunky vegetable soup of carrot, celery, zucchini and kale with tomatoes, white beans and small pasta. Better the next day, and freezes well.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one large bowl, a quarter of the pot.

ingredients.prep: small pasta shapes or broken spaghetti

steps.title: Soften the base
steps.text: Warm the oil in the pot and cook the onion, carrot and celery over medium heat until soft and sweet. Add the garlic for the last minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, water, oregano, salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently.

steps.title: Add zucchini and pasta
steps.text: Add the zucchini, beans and pasta and simmer until the pasta is tender, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Wilt the kale
steps.text: Stir in the kale and cook until just tender. Add a little water if the soup is very thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Taste for salt and pepper and serve with the basil scattered over.

recipes.name: Kale, sweet potato and quinoa bowl with tahini
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potato and chickpeas on quinoa with lemon-massaged kale and a loose tahini dressing. Every part can be made ahead for the week.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one bowl.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with the oil, paprika and half the salt on the tray. Roast, stirring halfway, until the potato is tender and the chickpeas are crisp.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.text: Simmer the quinoa in the water with a pinch of salt, covered, until the water is absorbed. Leave covered off the heat for five minutes, then fluff.

steps.title: Massage the kale
steps.text: Rub the kale with half the lemon juice and a pinch of salt for a minute, until it darkens and softens.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Whisk the tahini, garlic, the rest of the lemon juice and salt with 2 to 3 tablespoons of water until pourable.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Divide the quinoa and kale between two bowls, top with the sweet potato and chickpeas and spoon over the dressing.

recipes.name: Ginger soy tempeh with broccoli and brown rice
recipes.description: Cubes of tempeh and broccoli tossed in a glossy ginger, garlic and soy sauce over nutty brown rice. A simple stir-fry with real staying power.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the stir-fry with a third of the rice.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Simmer the brown rice in plenty of salted water until tender, then drain and return to the pot with the lid on.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, maple syrup, cornstarch and water together in the small bowl.

steps.title: Brown the tempeh
steps.text: Heat the oil in the wok over medium-high heat and fry the tempeh until golden on most sides. Push it to one side.

steps.title: Cook the broccoli
steps.text: Add the broccoli and two tablespoons of water, cover for two minutes to steam, then uncover and stir-fry until bright and just tender. Add the ginger and garlic for the last 30 seconds.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Stir the sauce, pour it in and toss until it thickens and coats everything. Serve over the rice with sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Black bean and sweet potato enchiladas
recipes.description: Corn tortillas rolled around a cumin-spiced black bean and sweet potato filling, baked under a quick tomato and chili sauce and finished with avocado.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is two enchiladas.

ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 1 cm cubes

steps.title: Cook the sweet potato
steps.text: Boil the sweet potato in salted water until just tender. Drain.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Heat half the oil in the pot, add half the onion and garlic and cook until soft. Add half the cumin, the chili powder, oregano, tomatoes and half the salt. Simmer for 10 minutes, then blend smooth.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). In the frying pan, cook the rest of the onion and garlic in the rest of the oil, then add the beans, sweet potato and the rest of the cumin and salt. Mash lightly.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Warm the tortillas so they bend without cracking. Spread a little sauce in the dish, fill each tortilla, roll it up and lay it seam down. Pour the rest of the sauce over.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with foil and bake until bubbling at the edges.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with avocado and coriander and serve two per person.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with lentil tomato sauce
recipes.description: A thick, slow-simmered sauce of lentils, tomato, carrot and celery spooned over spaghetti. Hearty, freezer-friendly and much cheaper than a meat sauce.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a quarter of the pasta and sauce.

steps.title: Cook the base
steps.text: Warm the oil in the frying pan and cook the onion, carrot and celery over medium heat until soft. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for a minute more.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils, tomatoes, water, oregano and salt. Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, stirring now and then and adding a splash of water if it gets dry, until the lentils are soft.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Towards the end, cook the spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water until just tender. Keep a cup of the cooking water, then drain.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.text: Toss the spaghetti with the sauce, loosening with a little cooking water. Serve with basil.

recipes.name: Seitan and pepper fajitas
recipes.description: Home-made seitan strips seared with charred peppers and onion in a smoky chili and lime seasoning, served in warm corn tortillas. Making the seitan takes 30 minutes and it keeps for days.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is three fajitas.

ingredients.prep: for the dough, plus more for simmering

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Mix the gluten and garlic powder in the bowl. Add the water and one tablespoon of the soy sauce and stir, then knead for two minutes until springy.

steps.title: Simmer the seitan
steps.text: Cut the dough into four pieces and stretch them flat. Put them in the pot with plenty of cold water and the rest of the soy sauce. Bring to a bare simmer (never a hard boil) and cook, turning once.

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Lift out the seitan, let it cool for a few minutes and squeeze out the excess liquid. Cut into thin strips.

steps.title: Char the vegetables
steps.text: Heat half the oil in the frying pan over high heat and cook the peppers and onion until softened and blackened in spots. Tip onto a plate.

steps.title: Sear the seitan
steps.text: Add the rest of the oil and the seitan strips, sprinkle with chili powder, cumin and paprika and fry until crisp at the edges. Return the vegetables and add the lime juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Warm the tortillas and serve with the filling and salsa for everyone to build their own.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach coconut curry
recipes.description: Chickpeas and spinach in a mild tomato and coconut sauce with golden turmeric, ginger and cumin. Ready in half an hour from cupboard ingredients.
equipment: large deep frying pan or pot
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a quarter of the pan with a quarter of the rice.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.text: Cook the rice in plenty of salted water until tender, then drain and keep covered.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.text: Warm the oil in the pan and cook the onion over medium heat until golden. Add the garlic and ginger for one minute.

steps.title: Toast the spices
steps.text: Stir in the cumin, coriander, turmeric and cayenne for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and cook until thick.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the chickpeas, coconut milk and salt and simmer gently.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then add the lime juice. Taste for salt and serve with the rice.

recipes.name: Spiced red lentil stew (misir wot style)
recipes.description: Red lentils cooked down with a lot of slowly softened onion, tomato paste and a home-mixed berbere-style spice blend of paprika, cayenne, fenugreek, ginger and cardamom. Rich, warming and deep red.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the pot. Serve with flatbread or rice.

steps.title: Mix the spice blend
steps.text: Stir the paprika, cayenne, fenugreek, ground ginger, cardamom, coriander and cinnamon together in the small bowl.

steps.title: Cook the onions down
steps.text: Put the onion in the dry pot over medium-low heat and stir until it gives off its water and starts to soften. Add the oil and keep cooking slowly, stirring often, until deep golden and jammy.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.text: Add the garlic, fresh ginger, tomato paste and the spice blend and stir for two minutes, until the oil turns red and the spices smell toasted.

steps.title: Cook the lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils, water and salt. Simmer, stirring often so nothing sticks, until the lentils have melted into a thick stew.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Taste and add more salt or cayenne. Serve hot with flatbread or rice.

recipes.name: Garlicky greens and potatoes (gomen style)
recipes.description: Kale braised slowly with onion, garlic, ginger and green chili, with soft potato cubes folded through. A gentle, savoury side or a light main.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the pot.

ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 2 cm cubes

steps.title: Soften the aromatics
steps.text: Warm the oil in the pot and cook the onion over medium heat until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, chili and turmeric and stir for a minute.

steps.title: Add the potatoes
steps.text: Add the potatoes, water and salt, cover and simmer until the potatoes are half cooked.

steps.title: Braise the greens
steps.text: Pile in the kale, cover and let it wilt, then stir and keep cooking gently, covered, until the kale is very tender and the potatoes are soft.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Uncover and let any extra liquid cook off. Stir in the lemon juice and taste for salt. Remove the chili before serving if you like less heat.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice with tofu and peas
recipes.description: Day-old rice fried hot with scrambled egg, golden tofu, peas, carrot and scallions, seasoned simply with soy and sesame. The best use for leftover rice.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the wok.

ingredients.prep: cooked the day before and chilled
crumbled with a pinch of turmeric
ingredients.note: Crumbled silken tofu in place of the eggs makes the rice vegan.

steps.title: Brown the tofu
steps.text: Heat half the oil in the wok over high heat and fry the tofu cubes until golden. Lift out onto a plate.

steps.title: Scramble the egg
steps.text: Pour the beaten eggs into the hot wok, let them set for a few seconds, then break into soft pieces. Add them to the tofu.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.text: Add the rest of the oil, then the carrot, garlic and the white parts of the scallions. Stir-fry for a minute, then add the peas.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.text: Add the cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry until every grain is hot and starting to crisp.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Return the tofu and egg, add the soy sauce, sesame oil and pepper and toss well. Finish with the green scallion tops.

recipes.name: Spicy tofu and mushroom braise
recipes.description: Soft cubes of tofu and chopped shiitake simmered in a spicy, savoury miso and chili sauce with ginger and garlic, spooned over rice. Bold but quick.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the braise with a third of the rice.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Cook the rice in plenty of salted water until tender. Drain and keep covered.

steps.title: Warm the tofu
steps.text: Slide the tofu cubes into a pan of gently simmering salted water for two minutes to firm them up, then lift out carefully.

steps.title: Fry the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat the oil in the wok and fry the shiitake until browned and fragrant. Add the garlic and ginger for a minute.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Stir in the miso, sriracha, cayenne, soy sauce and water and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Add the tofu and nudge it into the sauce without breaking it. Simmer gently, then stir the cornstarch mix and pour it in, shaking the pan until glossy and thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with scallions and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Squash and chickpea stew with couscous
recipes.description: Butternut squash, carrot and chickpeas simmered with cumin, cinnamon, ginger and a few raisins, served over fluffy couscous with fresh herbs. Sweet, warm and gently spiced.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a quarter of the stew with a quarter of the couscous.

ingredients.prep: peeled and cut into 3 cm chunks

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.text: Warm the oil in the pot and cook the onion until soft and golden. Add the garlic and all the spices and stir for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.text: Add the squash, carrot, tomatoes, water and salt. Cover and simmer until the squash is almost tender.

steps.title: Add chickpeas
steps.text: Stir in the chickpeas and raisins and simmer uncovered until the squash is soft and the sauce has thickened.

steps.title: Make the couscous
steps.text: Put the couscous in the heatproof bowl with a pinch of salt and pour over 1.5 cups of boiling water. Cover for five minutes, then fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir the lemon juice into the stew. Serve over the couscous with parsley scattered over.

recipes.name: Baked herb chickpea patties with tahini sauce
recipes.description: Falafel-inspired patties of chickpeas, parsley, coriander and cumin, bound with chickpea flour and baked rather than fried. Served with a lemony tahini sauce and salad.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is three patties with sauce and salad.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Line the tray with baking paper and brush it with a tablespoon of the oil.

steps.title: Blend the mixture
steps.text: Pulse the onion, garlic, parsley and coriander leaf until finely chopped. Add the chickpeas, chickpea flour, cumin, ground coriander, baking powder and salt and pulse to a coarse paste that holds together when pressed.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Shape into 12 small flat patties and set them on the tray. Brush the tops with the rest of the oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake, turning once halfway, until crisp and golden on both sides.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, a pinch of salt and 3 to 4 tablespoons of cold water until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the patties with the tomato and cucumber salad and plenty of tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Tofu and pea curry (matar style)
recipes.description: Golden tofu and sweet peas in a gently spiced onion, ginger and tomato gravy. A dairy-free take on the classic paneer and pea curry; paneer works too.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the pan. Serve with rice or flatbread.

ingredients.prep: pressed and cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.note: Paneer in place of tofu. Its protein is not known here (no USDA match), so the recipe total becomes not known.

steps.title: Brown the tofu
steps.text: Heat half the oil in the pan and fry the tofu cubes until golden on a few sides. Lift out.

steps.title: Cook the onion
steps.text: Add the rest of the oil and cook the onion until golden. Stir in the garlic, ginger and chili for one minute.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.text: Add the cumin, coriander and turmeric, stir for 30 seconds, then add the tomatoes and salt. Cook until thick and the oil shows at the edges. Blend it smooth if you like.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the water, peas and tofu and simmer until the peas are tender and the sauce coats the tofu.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with coriander and serve hot.

recipes.name: Stuffed peppers with rice, black beans and cheddar
recipes.description: Bell peppers baked with a filling of rice, black beans, corn, tomato and chili, finished with melted cheddar. A family-style tray bake.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one stuffed pepper.

ingredients.prep: tops cut off and seeds removed

ingredients.note: Sliced avocado in place of the cheddar makes the peppers vegan.

modifications.vegetarian: Cheddar may be made with animal rennet: choose one the label says uses microbial or vegetable rennet.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Cook the rice in plenty of salted water until just tender, then drain.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F). Cook the onion in the oil until soft, add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for a minute, then stir in the tomatoes, beans, corn, rice and salt.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Stand the peppers upright in the baking dish and pack them with the filling. Pour a few tablespoons of water into the dish.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with foil and bake until the peppers are tender.

steps.title: Add the cheese
steps.text: Uncover, top each pepper with cheddar and bake until melted and bubbling.

recipes.name: Whole-wheat pasta with mushrooms, spinach and ricotta
recipes.description: Whole-wheat pasta tossed with garlicky browned mushrooms, wilted spinach and spoonfuls of creamy ricotta loosened with pasta water and lemon. A weeknight dinner in 25 minutes.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a third of the pasta.

ingredients.note: White beans blended smooth in place of the ricotta make the pasta vegan.

modifications.vegetarian: Some ricotta is made with rennet: choose one the label says uses no animal rennet.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until just tender. Keep a cup of the cooking water before draining.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Meanwhile heat the oil in the frying pan over high heat. Add the mushrooms in one layer and leave them until browned underneath, then stir and cook until golden all over.

steps.title: Add garlic and spinach
steps.text: Add the garlic for one minute, then the spinach, stirring until it wilts. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the drained pasta, the ricotta, lemon juice and a splash of cooking water. Toss over low heat until creamy, adding more water as needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve straight away with more black pepper.

recipes.name: Coconut peanut curry with tofu and green beans
recipes.description: Crisp-edged tofu and green beans in a creamy coconut and peanut sauce with ginger, lime and a little chili, served over rice. Made without curry paste, so nothing fishy hides in it.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is a quarter of the curry with a quarter of the rice.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.text: Cook the rice in plenty of salted water until tender, then drain and keep covered.

steps.title: Crisp the tofu
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pan and fry the tofu until golden on several sides. Lift out.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.text: Lower the heat, add the garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander and cayenne and stir for 30 seconds. Whisk in the coconut milk, peanut butter and soy sauce until smooth.

steps.title: Simmer the vegetables
steps.text: Add the green beans and pepper and simmer until the beans are tender but still bright.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the tofu, stir in the lime juice and maple syrup and heat through. Taste, scatter with basil and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Three-bean and lentil chili
recipes.description: A thick, smoky chili of kidney, black and pinto beans with lentils, peppers and tomatoes. Cook a big pot: it tastes even better the next day.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is one large bowl, a fifth of the pot.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Warm the oil in the pot and cook the onion and peppers over medium heat until soft. Add the garlic for a minute.

steps.title: Toast the spices
steps.text: Stir in the chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano and tomato paste and cook for a minute until dark and fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the lentils
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, lentils, water and salt. Bring to the boil, then simmer partly covered, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Add the beans
steps.text: Add all three beans and simmer until the lentils are soft and the chili is thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir in the vinegar, taste for salt and heat, and serve topped with scallions.

recipes.name: Roasted red pepper and white bean dip
recipes.description: A bright orange dip of oven-roasted red peppers blended with white beans, garlic, lemon and smoked paprika. Great with raw vegetables or toasted pita.
recipes.servingNote: One serving is about a third of a cup of dip.

steps.title: Roast the peppers
steps.text: Heat the oven to 230 °C (450 °F). Roast the pepper halves skin side up until the skins blister and blacken.

steps.title: Steam and peel
steps.text: Put the hot peppers in a bowl, cover with a plate for 10 minutes, then slip off the skins.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the peppers with the beans, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, paprika and salt until smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Taste and adjust, then serve with the carrot and cucumber sticks. Keeps for four days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Peanut butter cocoa oat bites
recipes.description: No-bake bites of oats, peanut butter, dates, flaxseed and cocoa rolled into balls. A handy snack to keep in the fridge.
recipes.servingNote: Makes 12 bites. One serving is two bites.

steps.title: Blend the dates
steps.text: Pulse the dates in the food processor until they form a sticky paste.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add the oats, peanut butter, flaxseed, cocoa, vanilla and salt and pulse until the mixture clumps together. Add the water only if it seems dry.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll into 12 walnut-sized balls with damp hands and set them on the tray.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill for 30 minutes to firm up, then store in the container in the fridge for up to a week.
